# Pilot the cheat sheet against full documentation and freeze the choice
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #105, sha256:628bbc3b3d8861b21590020ac43b7292d1b9321fcf52dec51c942266dff7496c). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** data (thin slice; a pilot run and a Decider)
- **Milestone:** Measure first: does Phrase beat plain C# on tokens and attempts at an equal or better pass rate?
- **Source:** Decider D52 (2026-10-27): plain C# costs about 215 to 230 tokens per task while the Phrase docs-in-context arm charges about 4850 documentation tokens per attempt, so on the frozen token bar (D32) Phrase cannot win with the full documentation. D32 and D66 allow a compact cheat sheet only if it is committed and its hash recorded BEFORE the first scored row; this card and card 105 do that before card 101 runs.
- **Depends on:** 104
- **Story:** As Riley, I want a small pilot of the cheat sheet versus the full documentation on the development tasks, then one Decider that freezes which documentation the Phrase arm uses and its hash, so that the scored runs are not tuned after their numbers are seen.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given N=2 runs per model per development task for each documentation variant (full docs and cheat sheet), cold, scored by executed outcomes, When the pilot finishes, Then the rows are stored with labels pilot-fulldocs-rN and pilot-cheatsheet-rN and are excluded from the scored baseline (the check fails if a pilot row carries a scored label)
  2. Given the pilot rows, When they are summarized, Then pass rate, attempts and total tokens per variant are shown side by side and no verdict is stated
  3. Given the summary, When the Decider runs, Then it records which documentation the scored Phrase arm uses and the sha256 of every documentation file, before any scored row exists (scripts/check-decider-recorded.py cheatsheet-frozen passes)

## Context

- Tuning the sheet on the development tasks is allowed (they are the development suite); the sealed holdouts are untouched. After the freeze the sheet may not change without a new Decider and a fresh baseline.
- The pilot spends finite allotments; run it as a tracked background task. Only available models are included.
